name: motion-cover-flow
title: Cover Flow
description: Thẻ đang chọn nằm phẳng giữa khung, các thẻ hai bên xoay 60° và lùi sâu, việc chọn chuyển qua lại bằng lò xo.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Cards (68 x 92) in a row; the selected one flat at centre; others rotateY +-60 deg (facing the centre), z -80 to -120 px, x = 70 px x offset + 20 px gap per side, opacity 1 - min(0.6, 0.3 x |offset|). Selection moves on a spring (stiffness 200, damping 22-24, ~500 ms) through 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 1 -> 0 at 0.8 / 1.8 / 2.8 / 3.6 s. Params: angle (±60°) · depth (80–120 px) · spring (200 / 22). Opacity 1 − min(0.6, 0.3 |offset|). The small demo moves the selection 0 → 1 → 2 → 1 → 0; here it starts on the second of five cards so both sides show.
